title.en: emile parisien floating at the bimhuis.

line.de: emile parisien mit floating im bimhuis, 20:30 bis 22:00. das café öffnet um 18:30, also früh kommen für einen drink.
line.tr: bimhuis'ta emile parisien'in floating projesi, 20:30 - 22:00. kafe 18:30'da açılıyor, içki için erken gel.

sparks.why: Emile Parisien Floating at Bimhuis, Sat 14 nov 20:30 to 22:00, per the bimhuis.nl calendar and iamsterdam.com (both checked in search results).
